en.headline: CLP voltage dip traps people in lifts across Kowloon and New Territories
en.dek: A momentary sag on a 400-kilovolt line from Lai Chi Kok to Tsz Wan Shan at about 1.09pm prompted nearly 180 lift entrapment reports and dozens of false fire alarms; rescues are complete.
body: CLP Power said a 400-kilovolt transmission circuit linking Lai Chi Kok and Tsz Wan Shan recorded a brief voltage dip at about 1.09pm on Tuesday, though electricity supply was not interrupted.

The Fire Services Department said areas of Kowloon and the New Territories were affected. It received 178 to 179 reports of people trapped in lifts and about 39 to 40 reports of fire alarm activations. Rescue and follow-up work has been completed.
CLP said some customers may have seen lights dim or flicker, and sensitive equipment may have stopped operating when protective devices activated. The company said it is following up on the incident.

Reports mentioned incidents in districts including Tsim Sha Tsui, Kwun Tong, Tsuen Wan and Sheung Shui. In one case at Austin Road in Tsim Sha Tsui, two women were freed by firefighters after about 20 minutes; they were not injured.

zh.headline: 中電40萬伏特線路電壓驟降 九龍新界近180宗困升降機
zh.dek: 荔枝角至慈雲山供電線路下午約1時09分錄得短暫電壓驟降，電力無中斷；消防接獲近180宗困升降機及約40宗火警鐘誤鳴，救援已完成。
body: 中電表示，連接荔枝角至慈雲山的一組40萬伏特供電線路，今日下午約1時09分錄得短暫電壓驟降，期間電力供應並沒有中斷。
消防處指，九龍及新界部分地區受影響，共接獲178至179宗被困升降機報告，以及約39至40宗火警鐘鳴響報告，救援及跟進行動現已全部完成。
中電稱，電壓驟降期間部分客戶可能見到燈光轉暗或閃爍，一些對電壓變化較敏感的電力裝置或會因保護裝置啟動而暫停運作。中電正跟進事件。
受影響地區包括尖沙咀、觀塘、荃灣及上水等。尖沙咀柯士甸道一宗個案中，兩名女子被困約20分鐘後由消防員救出，並無受傷。
